2014_spells.mordenkainen-s-faithful-houn: Deal 4d8 piercing damage to a target within 30 ft

Using 1 action, when a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without first speaking the password that you specify when you cast the spell, the hound starts barking loudly. On a hit, it deals 4d8 piercing damage; At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you. You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.
